title: velvety ukrainian mixed grain bake
description: a rich ovo-vegetarian-friendly take on traditional ukrainian cuisine, featuring mixed grain and tempering chocolate. the perfect lazy-sunday dish for a cold winter day.

ingredients.name: tempering chocolate (250g high-cocoa-content chocolate chips)
ingredients.notes: do not use milk chocolate for best results

ingredients.name: coffee (25g)
ingredients.notes: optional, for added depth of flavor

instructions: combine the mixed grain, sour cream, eggs, sugar, and melted butter in a large bowl. mix until well combined.
add the tempering chocolate, vanilla extract, and sea salt to the grain mixture. mix until the chocolate is evenly distributed.
fold in the chopped walnuts, dried cranberries, and orange zest. if using coffee, add it now.
pour the mixture into a greased 20cm (8-inch) round cake pan or springform pan.
bake for 35 minutes, then reduce the oven temperature to 160°c (325°f) and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes. a toothpick inserted into the center should come out clean.
remove the bake from the oven and let it cool in the pan for 10 minutes before transferring it to a wire rack to cool completely.
once the bake has cooled, dust it with powdered sugar and serve.
